summary: nginx 1.31.10 and 1.30.8, released 23 November 2026, fix excessive CPU use in a worker when ssl_early_data is enabled. The vulnerable range on the nginx.org advisory is 1.21.4 through 1.31.9, except 1.30.8 and later on the 1.30 line. The 14 October floors stay 1.31.7 and 1.30.6.
remediation: Upgrade nginx to 1.31.10 or newer on the mainline, or to 1.30.8 or newer on the 1.30 stable line.
